verses.2: The wise man will respond with wisdom and make decisions wisely from the beginning.
verses.3: He who reveals a truth will not distort it, and he who uses words inappropriately will not make them effective.
verses.4: Even you will be ashamed, and your crops will be destroyed before God’s eyes.
verses.5: For your tongue will become weak, and you will choose to speak in a foolish manner.
verses.6: Your mouth will speak for you, and I won’t. Your words will respond to you.
verses.7: Man is born, and before his birth, he is sick.
verses.8: The Lord will hear your prayers, and wisdom will be given to you.
verses.9: What do you know? And we don’t know either. You can understand, but we don’t share that understanding with you.
verses.10: May both the poor and the rich be children of our Lord, from days long past.
verses.11: May God’s blessings be upon you, and may His words be with you always.
verses.12: What will your heart take, and what will your eyes cry out for?
verses.13: For you shall return to your Lord, and from your eyes shall be removed the tears.
verses.14: What kind of man can be righteous and holy, when he is the son of a woman?
verses.15: Nor in his holiness can he be trusted, nor can the heavens be seen by him.
verses.16: Even if a man is hated and despised, he still remains as pure as water.
verses.17: May your name be blessed upon me, and may my eyes see it. I will record it.
verses.18: Those who are wise will speak, and not those who follow in their fathers’ footsteps.
verses.19: To them alone was given the land; no stranger entered their midst.
verses.20: Every day, the wicked are punished. After many years, we can finally see them being destroyed.
verses.21: The voices of fear in his ears, but in peace, will bring us salvation.
verses.22: I cannot believe that from this darkness and uncertainty, it will indeed be Ely-Harav.
verses.23: He was led to the ground. How could he know that it would be in his hands on that dark day?
verses.24: He will be afflicted and suffer great hardships, just like a king who is about to be overthrown.
verses.25: Because his hand will reach to El, and his strength will increase.
verses.26: He rushed towards him with his head held high, standing on his feet.
verses.27: Because his face was covered with milk, he made a pillow over it.
verses.28: And those cities became desolate; their houses were uninhabited, as they had been planned to be destroyed.
verses.29: He will not rise up, nor will his army be able to stand against them. They will not be able to take control of the land.
verses.30: It is not allowed for darkness to cover me; it must be illuminated by light. And it is also forbidden for my eyes to be covered by darkness.
verses.31: Al-Ya’man baShivu Nita’ah ki-Shawa Tihyeh Temurotoh.
verses.32: Before time comes, its fullness and fulfillment will not be achieved.
verses.33: It will be like a rose in the garden; it will be thrown away as if it were worthless.
verses.34: For the wicked have been destroyed, and fire has consumed their shelters.
verses.35: They worked hard, and they gave birth to children. In their wombs, they prepared lies.
